title: Tenali Rama and the Half Reward

scenes.summary: A man complains about a greedy guard.
scenes.text: A man told the king that a palace guard took half his reward as a bribe.
scenes.image_prompt: man complaining to king about guard in royal court cartoon style

scenes.text: The guard denied taking anything, and the king asked Tenali to find the truth.
scenes.image_prompt: guard denying accusation in front of king cartoon

scenes.text: Tenali said he promised to share half his reward with the guard at the gate.
scenes.image_prompt: Tenali speaking cleverly while guard listens cartoon

scenes.text: The guard quickly agreed, saying he should get half of the reward.
scenes.image_prompt: guard eagerly asking for reward cartoon

scenes.summary: The truth is revealed and the guard is punished.
scenes.text: Tenali proved the guard’s greed. The king punished him and praised Tenali. Greed can expose the truth.
scenes.image_prompt: king punishing guard while Tenali smiles cartoon

story: A man complained that a guard took half his reward as a bribe. Tenali said he had promised to share a reward with the guard. The guard quickly agreed, revealing his greed. The king understood the truth and punished the guard.
